full_page.content:
1952, December 25
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE S HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Christmas Night 1952
Gloria in Excelsis Deo et Pax hominibus bonae. . of good will
God bless you Eileen Casey dear Niece of ours --
God bless you and yours.
Only now I come to your letter of Dec. 19º - after Il p.m. God help us! I hardly know how the time slips by. Your cousin Mildred called from Chicago a week or so back and I had a little word with several of them including Captain Florence Casey was just then being transerred to Detroit Mich. Thanks be to God they all seem to be well - including even your Aunt - "Grandma Grace". In
fact Grace gave me a pleasant surprise - a "congratu-
lations ... " on my 83rd birthday. Your Uncles Pat and Owen also wrote and Mgr. Edw'd. All well Dec Gr. !
(Note: The following is an Addition to the above) : 1953, February 16
Febr. 16 '53
Blessed be the Most Holy Trinity in every tick of time! God bless you Eileen again - two months after this was supposed to beyours. Looking for something quite dif- fierent late last night I felt ashamed of myself to find these cards still "just snowed under" (all kinds of let- ters, etc) Please God I'll get it off today. I hope you are keeping well these days - at once so restless, so foreboding in in the materialistic world; yet by the grace and mercy of God, so colorful and so promising!
